_journeys.notes: Entry SERPs are guides, state initiatives and AI Overviews; the AI Overview on files 01 and 06 independently tells the searcher to pick one repetitive task first, which matches the fix-one-job offer. Conversion SERPs are fully vendor-occupied with local packs that streamlinedai.tech is absent from. Bare 'how do i add ai to my business' and 'automate my business with ai' are polluted (start-an-AI-business videos, DIY tools) and are used as FAQ answers, never as a title or H1.

_journeys.persona: Owner-run construction and heavy industry contractor in Ireland (civils, groundworks, plant hire, quarry, readymix, precast, haulage, tippers, road surfacing, drain cleaning, demolition, council fleets) with an office of one to five people

conversion_queries: ai for construction companies near galway
ai for construction companies near ireland
_journeys.notes: Generic entry terms return US/UK SaaS ads and AI-tool listicles with zero Irish or bespoke results. Sector terms are held by Irish ERP and SaaS incumbents at the full-subscription end. Every sector capture NOTE names the same gap, dockets, weighbridge tickets, walkaround checks and job packs off paper for the small owner-run operator who does not want an ERP. File 13 shows Google itself suggesting 'near galway' and 'near ireland'.

_journeys.persona: Irish solar PV, heat pump, insulation or retrofit One Stop Shop installer (3 to 30 staff) carrying SEAI grant paperwork, quotes and job scheduling on spreadsheets

conversion_queries: solar installer job management software ireland
_journeys.notes: Both captured SERPs are led by design software, manufacturer tools and sales CRMs; jobflow.ie holds the only job-management slot on each at EUR59 a month. Position 6 on the solar query is a local pack of actual installer businesses, so part of that SERP is homeowner hire intent. No ranking result leads with grant pack, NC6 or NC7 paperwork. The 'seai grant software' autocomplete seed returned nothing, a coverage gap, so the grant page is fed from /installers rather than chased as a head term.

_journeys.persona: Irish business owner who has decided to get a custom app or system built rather than buy a SaaS subscription, asking about cost, time and who to trust, plus the Galway searcher looking for an app developer or AI consultant nearby

_journeys.notes: Cost is the PAA theme on three of the five SERPs. File 14's price anchor is hst.ie at EUR5,000 to 6,000 per month per engineer, which makes the public from EUR3,900 figure a differentiator.
